```{r}
# ================== Matching: prioritize NVIQ (KBIT) and Maternal Education; age last ==================
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(clue)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(rstatix)
# ---------------- File and columns ----------------
file <- "/Users/avantika/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/BDL/Member_Folders/Avantika/000_Projects/P_004_ELP_DLD/DataAnalysis/Subject_match_selection.xlsx"
sheet_orig <- "Phon_sub" # change the name of output as well
sheet_cand <- "All_sub"

id_col  <- "participant_id"
kbit    <- "KBIT_Nonverbal_StS"   # NVIQ
age     <- "Age_ses7"
sex     <- "sex"
hand    <- "Handedness_ses7"
edu     <- "Combined.Mother.Education"  # Maternal education (coded numeric)

# ---------------- Load data ----------------
orig <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file, sheet = sheet_orig, detectDates = FALSE)
cand <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file, sheet = sheet_cand, detectDates = FALSE)

need <- c(id_col, kbit, sex, age, hand, edu)
orig <- orig[, need]
cand <- cand[, need]
orig[[edu]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(orig[[edu]]))
cand[[edu]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cand[[edu]]))

# ---------------- Helpers ----------------
smd <- function(a, b) {
  a <- as.numeric(a); b <- as.numeric(b)
  (mean(a, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(b, na.rm = TRUE)) /
    sqrt((var(a, na.rm = TRUE) + var(b, na.rm = TRUE)) / 2)
}

match_stratum_factory <- function(w_kbit, w_age, w_edu, age_caliper, edu_caliper, kbit_caliper,
                                  bigM = 1e6) {
  force(w_kbit); force(w_age); force(w_edu)
  force(age_caliper); force(edu_caliper); force(kbit_caliper)
  function(O, C) {
    if (nrow(O) == 0 || nrow(C) == 0) return(tibble(orig_id = character(), cand_id = character()))
    n_o <- nrow(O); n_c <- nrow(C)
    cost <- matrix(0, n_o, n_c)
    for (i in seq_len(n_o)) for (j in seq_len(n_c)) {
      dk <- abs(O[[kbit]][i] - C[[kbit]][j])
      da <- abs(O[[age]][i]  - C[[age]][j])
      eo <- O[[edu]][i]; ec <- C[[edu]][j]

      # Hard calipers / constraints
      if (!is.na(kbit_caliper) && is.finite(dk) && dk > kbit_caliper) { cost[i,j] <- bigM; next }

      # Age is last priority: by default, no hard caliper unless user supplies one
      if (!is.na(age_caliper) && is.finite(da) && da > age_caliper) { cost[i,j] <- bigM; next }

      # Maternal education: exact match if edu_caliper == 0 (including missing-with-missing only)
      if (!is.na(edu_caliper) && is.finite(edu_caliper) && edu_caliper == 0) {
        # Disallow mismatched missingness
        if (xor(is.na(eo), is.na(ec))) { cost[i,j] <- bigM; next }
        # If both present, require exact equality
        if (!is.na(eo) && !is.na(ec) && eo != ec) { cost[i,j] <- bigM; next }
        de_eff <- 0
      } else {
        # Otherwise, allow small differences with a caliper if provided
        de <- if (is.na(eo) || is.na(ec)) NA_real_ else abs(eo - ec)
        if (!is.na(edu_caliper) && is.finite(de) && de > edu_caliper) { cost[i,j] <- bigM; next }
        de_eff <- if (is.na(de)) 0.5 else de
      }

      # Objective: prioritize KBIT and education; age has the lowest weight
      if (!is.finite(dk) || !is.finite(da)) {
        cost[i,j] <- bigM
      } else {
        cost[i, j] <- w_kbit*dk + w_edu*de_eff + w_age*da
      }
    }
    # Solve assignment (pad if needed)
    if (n_c < n_o) {
      finite_cost <- cost[cost <  bigM]
      pad_val <- if (length(finite_cost)) max(finite_cost) * 10 else bigM
      pad <- matrix(pad_val, nrow = n_o, ncol = (n_o - n_c))
      cost <- cbind(cost, pad)
      sol <- solve_LSAP(cost)
      keep <- which(sol <= n_c)
      rows <- keep; cols <- sol[keep]
    } else {
      sol <- solve_LSAP(cost)
      rows <- seq_len(n_o); cols <- sol
    }
    tibble(orig_id = O[[id_col]][rows], cand_id = C[[id_col]][cols])
  }
}

run_match <- function(w_kbit, w_age, w_edu, age_caliper, edu_caliper, kbit_caliper) {
  match_stratum <- match_stratum_factory(w_kbit, w_age, w_edu, age_caliper, edu_caliper, kbit_caliper)
  strata <- orig |>
    distinct(across(all_of(c(sex, hand)))) |>
    arrange(.data[[sex]], .data[[hand]])

  pairs <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(strata)), function(s) {
    s_sex  <- strata[[sex]][s]
    s_hand <- strata[[hand]][s]
    O <- orig |> filter(.data[[sex]] == s_sex, .data[[hand]] == s_hand)
    C <- cand |> filter(.data[[sex]] == s_sex, .data[[hand]] == s_hand)
    match_stratum(O, C)
  }) |>
    distinct(cand_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    distinct(orig_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  m <- pairs |>
    left_join(orig |> rename_with(~paste0("orig_", .x)), by = c("orig_id" = paste0("orig_", id_col))) |>
    left_join(cand |> rename_with(~paste0("cand_", .x)), by = c("cand_id" = paste0("cand_", id_col)))

  # Diagnostics
  kbit_orig <- m[[paste0("orig_", kbit)]]
  kbit_cand <- m[[paste0("cand_", kbit)]]
  age_orig  <- m[[paste0("orig_", age)]]
  age_cand  <- m[[paste0("cand_", age)]]
  edu_orig  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m[[paste0("orig_", edu)]]))
  edu_cand  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m[[paste0("cand_", edu)]]))

  keep_edu  <- is.finite(edu_orig) & is.finite(edu_cand)

  list(
    pairs = pairs,
    m = m,
    kbit_smd = smd(kbit_orig, kbit_cand),
    age_smd  = smd(age_orig,  age_cand),
    edu_smd  = if (sum(keep_edu) > 1) smd(edu_orig[keep_edu], edu_cand[keep_edu]) else NA_real_,
    kbit_p   = tryCatch(t.test(kbit_orig, kbit_cand, paired = FALSE, var.EQUAL = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    age_p    = tryCatch(t.test(age_orig,  age_cand,  paired = FALSE, var.EQUAL = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    edu_p    = if (sum(keep_edu) > 1) tryCatch(t.test(edu_orig[keep_edu], edu_cand[keep_edu], paired = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_
  )
}

# ---------------- Auto-tune grid (Age = last priority) ----------------
# High weights on KBIT and Education, very low weight on Age, strict KBIT caliper, exact Education
grid <- expand.grid(
  w_kbit = c(12, 16, 20),     # prioritize NVIQ
  w_age  = c(0.25, 0.5, 1),   # age last
  w_edu  = c(10, 14, 18),     # prioritize education
  age_caliper  = NA_real_,    # no hard age caliper
  edu_caliper  = 1,           # exact maternal education (including missing-with-missing only)
  kbit_caliper = c(3, 4, 5),  # tight KBIT caliper
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE
)

results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
  g <- grid[i, ]
  c(as.list(g), run_match(g$w_kbit, g$w_age, g$w_edu, g$age_caliper, g$edu_caliper, g$kbit_caliper))
})

# Require: KBIT p > 0.05, Education p > 0.05 (Age is last priority, no requirement)
feasible_idx <- which(sapply(results, function(x)
  !is.na(x$kbit_p) && x$kbit_p > 0.05 &&
  (is.na(x$edu_p) || x$edu_p > 0.05)
))

best <- if (length(feasible_idx)) {
  feasible <- results[feasible_idx]
  # Among feasible, minimize KBIT SMD first, then Education SMD, then Age SMD (age last)
  idx <- order(
    sapply(feasible, function(x) abs(x$kbit_smd)),
    sapply(feasible, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x$edu_smd), Inf, abs(x$edu_smd))),
    sapply(feasible, function(x) abs(x$age_smd))
  )[1]
  feasible[[idx]]
} else {
  message("No solution met KBIT and Education thresholds with this grid. Consider loosening KBIT caliper slightly or expanding candidates.")
  # Fallback: maximize KBIT p, then Education p, then Age p, then minimize |Age SMD| (age last)
  idx <- order(
    sapply(results, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x$kbit_p), -Inf, x$kbit_p)),
    sapply(results, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x$edu_p), -Inf, x$edu_p)),
    sapply(results, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x$age_p), -Inf, x$age_p)),
    -sapply(results, function(x) abs(x$age_smd)),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )[1]
  results[[idx]]
}

# ---------------- Report best solution ----------------
m <- best$m
pairs <- best$pairs

kbit_orig <- m[[paste0("orig_", kbit)]]
kbit_cand <- m[[paste0("cand_", kbit)]]
age_orig  <- m[[paste0("orig_", age)]]
age_cand  <- m[[paste0("cand_", age)]]
edu_orig  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m[[paste0("orig_", edu)]]))
edu_cand  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m[[paste0("cand_", edu)]]))
keep_edu  <- is.finite(edu_orig) & is.finite(edu_cand)

tt_kbit <- t.test(kbit_orig, kbit_cand, paired = FALSE, var.EQUAL = FALSE)
tt_age  <- t.test(age_orig,  age_cand,  paired = FALSE, var.EQUAL = FALSE)
wx_edu  <- if (sum(keep_edu) > 1) suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(edu_orig[keep_edu], edu_cand[keep_edu], paired = FALSE, exact = FALSE)) else NULL

cat("\nBest parameters found (Age last priority):\n")
print(data.frame(
  w_kbit = best$w_kbit, w_age = best$w_age, w_edu = best$w_edu,
  age_caliper = best$age_caliper, edu_caliper = best$edu_caliper, kbit_caliper = best$kbit_caliper
))

med_edu_orig <- if (sum(keep_edu) > 0) median(edu_orig[keep_edu], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
med_edu_cand <- if (sum(keep_edu) > 0) median(edu_cand[keep_edu], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_

# Rank-biserial effect size using rstatix
eff_edu <- if (sum(keep_edu) > 1) {
  df_edu <- data.frame(
    group = factor(c(rep("orig", sum(keep_edu)), rep("cand", sum(keep_edu))),
                   levels = c("orig", "cand")),
    value = c(edu_orig[keep_edu], edu_cand[keep_edu])
  )
  rstatix::wilcox_effsize(df_edu, value ~ group, paired = FALSE, ci = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95)
} else {
  NULL
}

cat("\nDiagnostics:\n")
cat("Matched pairs:", nrow(m), "\n")
# Kbit comparison rseults
cat("KBIT (NVIQ) means (orig vs cand): ",
    round(mean(kbit_orig), 2), "vs", round(mean(kbit_cand), 2),
    "| SMD:", round(best$kbit_smd, 3),
    "| Welch t-test p:", signif(best$kbit_p, 4), "\n")
# Age comparison results
cat("Age  means (orig vs cand): ",
    round(mean(age_orig), 3),  "vs", round(mean(age_cand), 3),
    "| SMD:", round(best$age_smd, 3),
    "| Welch t-test p:", signif(best$age_p, 4), "\n")


if (sum(keep_edu) > 1) {
  # Extract effect size info if available
  if (!is.null(eff_edu) && nrow(eff_edu) > 0) {
    r_rb  <- eff_edu$effsize[1]
    ci_lo <- eff_edu$conf.low[1]
    ci_hi <- eff_edu$conf.high[1]
    mag   <- eff_edu$magnitude[1]
    eff_txt <- sprintf(" | rank-biserial r: %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f] (%s)", r_rb, ci_lo, ci_hi, mag)
  } else {
    eff_txt <- ""
  }

  cat("Maternal Education (orig vs cand) medians:",
      round(med_edu_orig, 2), "vs", round(med_edu_cand, 2),
      "| SMD:", round(best$edu_smd, 3),
      if (!is.null(wx_edu)) paste0(" | Wilcoxon rank-sum p:", signif(wx_edu$p.value, 4)) else "",
      eff_txt,
      "\n")

  edu_equal <- edu_orig == edu_cand
  cat("Maternal Education: exact matches (non-missing):",
      round(mean(edu_equal[keep_edu], na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      sprintf("  (%d/%d pairs)", sum(edu_equal[keep_edu], na.rm = TRUE), sum(keep_edu)), "\n")
} else {
  cat("Maternal Education: insufficient non-missing pairs for testing.\n")
}

# ---------------- Output matched table ----------------
matched_pairs <- m |>
  select(orig_id, cand_id,
         orig_kbit = paste0("orig_", kbit),
         cand_kbit = paste0("cand_", kbit),
         orig_age  = paste0("orig_", age),
         cand_age  = paste0("cand_", age),
         orig_sex  = paste0("orig_", sex),
         cand_sex  = paste0("cand_", sex),
         orig_hand = paste0("orig_", hand),
         cand_hand = paste0("cand_", hand),
         orig_edu  = paste0("orig_", edu),
         cand_edu  = paste0("cand_", edu))

cat("\nMatched pairs (first few rows):\n")
print(head(matched_pairs, 10))

# Optionally save:
openxlsx::write.xlsx(matched_pairs, "matched_pairs_phon.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
# ===========================================================================
```
